selection_basis: identity, baseline-expression availability, valid response presence, and coverage only; no response magnitude or model performance
external_precision_preference: If at least eight distinct eligible chemicals have >=80 external biological groups, rank within that pool first; otherwise use the prespecified >=50 minimum. This feasibility choice is made before response inspection/model fitting.
external_design_preference: CTRP models/groups absent from all GDSC2 development, if enough coverage; otherwise global group holdout
identity_rules: authoritative exact IDs first; unresolved and conflicting mappings excluded, not guessed
biological_group_rules: union canonical model identity, known patient and parent/derivative relations across Sanger and Broad
compound_rules: require corroborated identity; preserve assay-specific GDSC DRUG_ID and CTRP master_cpd_id
ranking_refinement_reason: Known related cell models are grouped; independent biological group counts, not repeated related models, drive prospective coverage ranking.
gdsc_dose_range_rule: Select one exact MIN_CONC/MAX_CONC pair per DRUG_ID by eligible biological-group coverage, then model coverage, then numeric MIN_CONC/MAX_CONC ascending; preserve other ranges as excluded from primary. No response magnitudes used.
ctrp_primary_identity_qc: SNP-matched-reference only; SNP-unconfirmed and SNP-not-tested reserved for secondary sensitivity, not treated as proven misidentification
ctrp_curve_qc: Published curves_post_qc membership plus finite response presence; no new dose-point or response-magnitude filter
ctrp_repeated_experiment_rule: After model freeze, median response of eligible experiments per compound/canonical model; never count repeats as independent models
duplicate_assay_rule: one primary GDSC assay ID per chemical identity by coverage then smallest ID; preserve alternatives separately
external_response_handling: identities and presence used for this stage; response values never used to rank drugs or choose split
notes: Sample-size thresholds are project feasibility targets, not universal statistical guarantees. No model fitting at this stage.
